name: SEO Fury
author: SEO Fury Team

sections.description:
SEO Fury is a comprehensive, lightweight SEO plugin that gives you full control over your site’s search engine optimization without slowing it down.

Core Features (Free)

  • Meta Titles & Descriptions — Customize title tags and meta descriptions for every post, page, and custom post type. Dynamic shortcode variables for automated templates.
  • Open Graph & Twitter Cards — Full social media preview control with image, title, and description customization.
  • XML & HTML Sitemaps — Automatic XML sitemaps with per-post-type and per-taxonomy sub-sitemaps. HTML sitemap page with shortcode support.
  • Schema Markup (JSON-LD) — 20+ schema types: Article, Product, FAQ, How-To, Recipe, Event, LocalBusiness, Organization, and more. Visual schema builder in the post editor.
  • Redirects — 301/302 redirect manager with regex support, hit tracking, and CSV import/export (50 redirects on free plan).
  • Robots.txt Editor — Visual robots.txt editor with per-user-agent rules, crawl-delay, dynamic variables.
  • 404 Monitor — Track 404 errors with automatic cleanup, email digest notifications (100 logs on free plan).
  • IndexNow — Instant indexing notifications to Bing, Yandex, and other search engines when you publish or update content.
  • Breadcrumbs — SEO-friendly breadcrumb navigation with shortcode, customizable separators, and auto-insert option.
  • Page Speed Analysis — Google PageSpeed Insights integration for performance monitoring.
  • Internal Link Analysis — See internal link statistics for every post directly in the editor.
  • WooCommerce SEO — Automatic Product schema, optimized meta tags for shop pages.
  • Local SEO — Organization and LocalBusiness schema output on your homepage.
  • Site Verification — Google, Bing, and Yandex webmaster verification tokens.
  • Hreflang Tags — Multilingual support with WPML, Polylang, and TranslatePress integration.
  • LLMs.txt — Generate LLMs.txt file for AI crawler guidance.
  • SEO Revisions — Track changes to SEO fields per post.
  • Easy Migration — One-click import from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress.
  • Import/Export — Backup and restore all plugin settings.

PRO Features (Addon)

Unlock advanced features with the SEO Fury PRO addon:

  • Unlimited Redirects & 404 Monitoring
  • Google Analytics (GA4), Yandex Metrika, Bing UET integration
  • Rank Tracker — monitor keyword positions across search engines
  • Google Search Console integration
  • Google Indexing API
  • AI Content Generation (WooCommerce product descriptions)
  • AI Image Generation & SEO Image Optimization
  • Backlink Checker
  • Link Assistant — internal linking suggestions
  • Content Decay detection
  • SEO Audit
  • Email & Telegram SEO Reports
  • White Label mode
  • Priority Support

External services

This plugin connects to external services in specific situations. No data is sent without user action.

IndexNow API

When you use the IndexNow feature to submit URLs for indexing, the plugin sends your page URLs to the IndexNow API.

  • Service URL: https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow
  • What is sent: Your site URLs and IndexNow API key
  • When: Only when you manually submit URLs or enable automatic submission on publish
  • IndexNow Terms of Use
  • IndexNow Privacy Policy

Google PageSpeed Insights API

When you use the PageSpeed analysis feature, the plugin sends your page URL to Google’s PageSpeed Insights API to retrieve performance metrics.

  • Service URL: https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed
  • What is sent: The URL of the page being analyzed
  • When: Only when you manually click “Analyze” in the PageSpeed tab
  • Google API Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy

Google Sitemap Ping

When enabled in sitemap settings (disabled by default), the plugin notifies Google that your sitemap has been updated.

  • Service URL: https://www.google.com/ping
  • What is sent: Your sitemap URL
  • When: Only when the option is enabled AND content is published or sitemap settings change
  • Google Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy

SEO Fury Services (PRO only)

The PRO addon connects to SEO Fury servers for support tickets and changelog information.

  • Service URL: https://api.seo-fury.com and https://seo-fury.com
  • What is sent: Support ticket content (when submitting tickets), plugin version (when checking changelog)
  • When: Only when using the Support tab or viewing the changelog
  • SEO Fury Terms of Service
  • SEO Fury Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-fury folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to SEO Fury in the admin sidebar to configure settings.
  4. (Optional) Install the SEO Fury PRO addon for advanced features.
sections.faq:
Does SEO Fury work with WooCommerce?

Yes. SEO Fury automatically generates Product schema for WooCommerce products and optimizes meta tags for shop, category, and tag pages.

Can I migrate from Yoast, Rank Math, or AIOSEO?

Yes. SEO Fury includes a built-in migration wizard that imports your existing SEO data from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress with one click.

Is SEO Fury compatible with page builders?

Yes. SEO Fury works with Gutenberg, the Classic Editor, and Elementor.

What is the PRO addon?

SEO Fury PRO is a separate plugin that installs alongside the free version and unlocks advanced features like analytics integration, rank tracking, AI content generation, and more. Purchase a license at seo-fury.com.

Does the free version make external API calls?

The free version only contacts external services when you explicitly trigger actions: IndexNow submissions (to search engines) and PageSpeed analysis (to Google). No background license checking or telemetry.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Separated free and PRO functionality into standalone plugins.
  • Added filter-based extension API for PRO addon compatibility.
  • All core SEO features available for free without license requirements.
